task: Find the GitHub repository microsoft/playwright, open its Releases section, and extract the latest release information as JSON.

latest_release.title: v1.60.0
latest_release.author: yury-s
latest_release.release_notes: HAR recording added as a first-class tracing API with tracing.startHar()/stopHar(); new locator.drop() for simulating external drag-and-drop; aria snapshot improvements including page-level assertions and bounding boxes; new test.abort() for aborting a running test; additional APIs and improvements across browser/context/page events, locators/assertions, network, errors/reporting, test runner, HTML reporter, and Trace Viewer. Breaking changes include removal of long-deprecated APIs such as Locator.ariaRef(), exposeBinding handle option, logger option on connect/connectOverCDP, and videosPath/videoSize context options. Browser versions: Chromium 148.0.7778.96, Firefox 150.0.2, WebKit 26.4; also tested against Chrome 147 and Edge 147.
